# Frederick Armando — Lead Product Designer

> Portfolio of Frederick Armando, Lead Product Designer focused on complex digital products, AI-powered experiences, mobile UX, B2B/B2C services, accessibility and product strategy.

Frederick Armando is a Lead Product Designer based in France. His work focuses on transforming complex user, business and technical constraints into clear, usable and measurable product experiences.

Key areas:
- Product strategy
- Conversational AI
- Mobile UX
- B2B/B2C products
- Accessibility
- Design systems
- UX research and product discovery

## Core pages

- [Home](https://frederickarmando.fr/): Overview, positioning and selected entry points.
- [Profile](https://frederickarmando.fr/profil): Career overview, skills and product design focus.
- [Methods](https://frederickarmando.fr/methodes): Product design approach from framing to measurement.
- [Projects](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets): Selected case studies and product work.
- [Contact](https://frederickarmando.fr/contact): Contact information and collaboration availability.

## Case studies

- [Michelin Tire Assistant](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/michelin-tire-assistant): Case study about transforming a passive B2C chatbot into a proactive engagement and conversion lever.
- [Michelin MyXpert](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/michelin-myxpert): Case study about centralizing Michelin technical expertise in a native B2B/B2E app.
- [Masteos](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/masteos): Case study about simplifying B2C real estate investment journeys.
- [Helios](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/helios): Case study about improving internal operations through a custom back-office experience.
- [Kirrk](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/kirrk): Case study about designing a B2B/B2C car-sharing and fleet-management ecosystem.
- [Mobioos](https://frederickarmando.fr/projets/mobioos): Case study about turning complex no-code application customization into a clearer B2B SaaS experience.
